# 0.20.0 — 2 November 2026

Minor release on 0.19.0. `validate` compiles every rule a deploy would compile, so a rule that validates deploys. The query checks, from [opentidehq/language-server 0.7.0](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.7.0), know the documented tables and their columns, and a workspace's `visibility.toml` declares its own datasets. `lint.toml` sets the filename convention, and Agent Plugins can start opentide's MCP server and skills.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install opentide==0.20.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict              # now also compiles each rule
```

| Before | Now |
|--------|-----|
| A rule the platform compiler could not build passed `validate` and failed at deploy (`✗ would fail`) | `validate` fails it (exit `1`) with the dry run's code (`compile_missing_field`, ...) at the key at fault |
| A near miss of a documented column passed the offline query check | `kql_unknown_column` / `kql_type_mismatch` / `spl_unknown_datamodel_field` / `ecs_type_mismatch` (errors); `--queries warn` while you fix them |
| An unknown table under the `sentinel` profile was an error | a warning; declare your own tables in `visibility.toml` |
| `validate query --live` set `VALIDATION_ERROR_RAISED` / `VALIDATION_WARNING_RAISED` | the flags are gone; read the exit code (unchanged), or `report_outcome(report)` from Python |
| `validation_exit_code`, `exit_on_validation_errors` | removed; `validation_outcome(failed=, warned=)` and `report_outcome(report)` |

## Added

- **`validate` fails a rule a platform compiler cannot build** ([#660](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/660)).
- **A `visibility.toml` log source names the datasets it fills** ([#695](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/695)): tables, Splunk indexes, sourcetypes and macros, Elastic indices and data views, and whether they follow ECS. Undeclared-dataset warnings are opt-in.
- **`lint.toml` can set the filename convention** ([#699](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/699)): `[filenames] style` and `pattern`, with a new `filename_pattern` finding.
- **`opentide setup skills --plugin`** enables the opentidehq/skills Agent Plugin in `.claude/settings.json`; **the MCP server finds the workspace when an Agent Plugin starts it**; **`setup mcp --generic`** writes an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 `mcp.json` ([#431](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/431)).
- **`opentide lint` reports the engine's ECS findings** and its undeclared-dataset warnings.

## Changed

- **The engine is language-server 0.7.0, from crates.io**: table and column knowledge for KQL (Azure Monitor Logs, Defender XDR, ASIM), the whole CIM for SPL, ECS for Elastic; more KQL forms parse; KQL hover shows column descriptions.
- **`validate query --live` runs on the `opentide query` runners** ([#673](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/673)); a Sentinel or Defender rule's tenant exclusions are in the checked query.

## Fixed

- **Deploy errors no longer say "MDR"** ([#617](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/617)).
- **`opentide doctor` no longer reports fresh templates as stale** in a workspace that sets `[metadata].required` in `lint.toml`.

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/CHANGELOG.md) for every change.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.20.0
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.20.0
opentide doctor                                             # analysis_engine: language server 0.7.0
```
